messages.subject: Dashboard body background limited height
parts:
Hi,

I am building my Shiny app using shinydashboard and have a question about dashboardBody(). I have several elements shown in the body of the dashboard and they take more than one screen in height. Interestingly, the rectangular shape that makes the background of the dashboard is only one-screen high. What should I do to adjust this?

Thanks

messages.author: 3fd19fd766bba142
messages.subject: Re: Dashboard body background limited height
parts:
Resolved

It was a side-effect of not using fluidRow().
